description: Pytest injects a fixture value without a Python call from the test to the fixture.

expected_affected.tests/test_fixture.py::test_quote: Under intended pytest fixture injection, quoted is produced by the fixture calling changed core.price.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.

false_negatives.tests/test_fixture.py::test_quote: Fixture-name injection supplies no indexed call/import edge from the test to conftest.quoted.

limitations: Pytest fixture discovery/injection is not modeled. These sources are never collected or executed by the corpus runner.
